text: Why must a link budget be compared against receiver sensitivity AT THE DESIRED DATA RATE?
choices: Sensitivity is far better for low modulations than for high ones, so a link that 'works' may be working at a twentieth of the expected rate
Data rate does not affect sensitivity
explanation: Quoting a single sensitivity figure hides the fact that 4096-QAM needs perhaps 40 dB of SNR while BPSK needs a few. A link with adequate margin for the lowest rate and none for the highest is a link that connects and disappoints.
